description: Defines interfaces and classes for a Worker Pool system, including job management, scheduling, revoking, and monitoring functionalities within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: IWorkerPool
classes.description: Interface for a worker pool managing job submission, scheduling, revoking, and snapshotting.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Implementation of IWorkerPool managing thread pool, scheduling, timers, and monitoring.

methods.name: JobType
methods.description: Template class representing a job type within the worker pool, supporting submit, reschedule, and revoke operations.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the worker pool is available.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the worker pool.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job to run at a specified time.

methods.name: Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules a job to a new time.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a scheduled or running job.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Waits for all jobs to complete.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns thread ID for a given index.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Returns current snapshot of worker pool status.
